mapper.sql: id, voucher_code, company_id, voucher_date, period, summary, source_type, source_ref_id, total_debit, total_credit, entries_json, attachments, agent_task_id, status, reviewed_by, reviewed_time, posted_by, posted_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN direction_via_total_credit = 0 THEN total_credit ELSE 0 END) AS today_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN direction_via_total_credit = 1 THEN total_credit ELSE 0 END) AS today_expense, COUNT(*) AS voucher_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REVIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_review FROM opc_finance_voucher WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND voucher_date = #{bizDate}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_credit), 0) AS taxable_amount, COALESCE(SUM(total_debit), 0) AS input_tax, COUNT(*) AS voucher_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'POSTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posted_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('DRAFT','REVIEW') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count FROM opc_finance_voucher WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND DATE_FORMAT(voucher_date, '%Y-%m') = #{period}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO opc_finance_voucher ( voucher_code, company_id, voucher_date, period, summary, source_type, source_ref_id, total_debit, total_credit, entries_json, attachments, agent_task_id, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{voucherCode}, #{companyId}, #{voucherDate}, #{period}, #{summary}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceRefId}, #{totalDebit}, #{totalCredit}, #{entriesJson}, #{attachments}, #{agentTaskId}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW() )
